label: Weather-implied generation. What the weather says these plants should produce, from open-source models (windpowerlib) and public plant data. Not a forecast of metered output and not any plant's schedule.
attribution: Contains information from the Wind Turbine Library (OpenEnergy Platform, supply.wind_turbine_library, (c) Reiner Lemoine Institut), which is made available under the Open Database License (ODbL-1.0): https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/
calibration_fit_leads_basis: derived by this route: implied_gen_calibration holds no lead columns, so fit_lead_min/fit_lead_max are the min/max lead_h of the area's rows of the line's band whose target falls on a Pacific day in [fit_start, fit_end], with scored_registry_mw > 0, written before fitted_at (the writer's fit rule). fit_rows counts them; the line's n_hours is fewer where an hour had no actual.
caiso_dam_issued: CAISO's day-ahead is issued between 06:09 PT the day before and 06:09 PT on the day

export_caps.export_cap_basis: SunZia HVDC delivers 2,131 MW of its 3,021 MW line to California via Palo Verde (EIA Today in Energy 67766); lower all-hours error than the 3,021 MW line cap on September 2026 (d091589 Step 1)
